agentUtterance.text:
Please check if the battery is inserted and charging in your modem. 
When you’re done, just let me know if you were able to complete the step.
Awesome! I’m glad to hear that your services are working again. Thank you for contacting us.

playbookInput.precedingConversationSummary: User having a problem with the service and initiating Virtual repair session.

playbookOutput.executionSummary: Bot asks the question and just in the middle of the conversation, service starts to function. Bot then routes the bell_feedback flow
